title: QuickBooks Alternative: Simple Invoicing vs Accounting Bloat | Invoicor
meta_description: Tired of QuickBooks' complex accounting features and high monthly fees? Discover why freelancers and small businesses are switching to Invoicor for simple, fast invoicing.
h1: Stop paying for accounting features you never use.
subtitle: QuickBooks is built for accountants managing double-entry bookkeeping, chart of accounts, vendor lists, and quarterly tax filings. Invoicor is built for one job: helping freelancers and contractors send a clean invoice from their phone and get paid the same day. If you don't have an accounting department, you're paying for software you'll never fully use.
mistake_1_text: QuickBooks bundles payroll, inventory tracking, mileage logs, 1099 contractor management, and tax forecasting into your subscription. If you're a solo freelancer or two-person trade business, you're paying premium prices for a dashboard with dozens of tabs you'll never open. The features look impressive in the demo, but you only use the invoicing one.
mistake_2_text: Try generating a quick invoice from the QuickBooks mobile app while standing on a job site. You'll navigate through customer setup, item catalog matching, sales tax configuration, and income account selection before you can even add a line item. What should take 60 seconds turns into a 10-minute interruption to your actual work.
mistake_3_text: QuickBooks Online is well-known for offering aggressive introductory discounts (often 50% off for the first 3 months), then renewing at the full sticker price. Combined with the annual price increases Intuit has pushed through year after year, the plan you signed up for at $30/month can quietly become $90/month within 18 months.
policy_text: When software tries to do everything, every individual task gets harder. QuickBooks forces you to set up a chart of accounts, map income categories, configure sales tax jurisdictions, and create vendor profiles before you can send a single invoice. This makes sense if you're a CPA managing a portfolio of clients. It doesn't make sense if you're a plumber who just finished a job and wants to text the customer a bill before driving home.
solution_text: Invoicor strips away every layer of accounting infrastructure that isn't directly required to send an invoice and accept payment. There is no chart of accounts. There is no income category mapping. You create an invoice, attach a payment link, and hit send. Your clients pay instantly via card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay, and at tax time you export a clean CSV your accountant can actually read.
stat_1_desc: Average time to draft and send a complete invoice from the Invoicor iOS app, including line items, tax, and a secure payment link.
stat_2_desc: Typical annual difference for a solo freelancer between an Invoicor subscription and a comparable QuickBooks Online plan after introductory pricing expires.
pricing_them_subtext: QuickBooks Online plans start with introductory discounts but scale aggressively. Adding payroll, time tracking, or extra users pushes total monthly cost well above $50 for most small businesses.
pricing_us_subtext: Flat-rate price with no introductory pricing games. Includes unlimited invoices, unlimited clients, multi-business profile switching, and access to every premium template.
target_audience_title: Who is each platform actually built for?
target_audience_us: Solo freelancers, trade contractors, consultants, designers, and small service businesses (1-3 people) who send between 5 and 100 invoices per month and want zero accounting setup time.
target_audience_them: Established small-to-mid-sized businesses (10+ employees), companies with dedicated bookkeepers or in-house accountants, and certified public accountants managing the books for multiple client businesses.
step_1_text: Open Invoicor, pick the client from your library (or add a new one in two taps), then tap saved line items to assemble the invoice. Your business details, logo, tax rate, and currency are already populated from your profile.
step_2_text: Send the invoice by email or text message with an embedded secure 'Pay Now' button. Your client doesn't have to download anything, create an account, or log in to view or pay.
step_3_text: Clients pay via credit card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay directly from their phone in seconds. You get an instant push notification the moment payment clears, and funds route straight to your bank.

faqs.question: Can I export my Invoicor data for my accountant at tax time?
faqs.answer: Yes. Invoicor isn't a double-entry bookkeeping tool, but you can export your complete invoice history, payment records, and client list as a clean CSV at any time. Most accountants find this format easier to work with than a QuickBooks Online export, since there are no income account mappings or vendor lists to untangle.

faqs.question: Will my clients need to create an account to pay me?
faqs.answer: Never. When you send an invoice through Invoicor, your client receives a link to a secure web portal where they can view the full invoice and pay instantly. No app download, no account creation, no login screen. This is a major friction reduction compared to portals that require client registration.

faqs.question: Does Invoicor handle sales tax or VAT?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure default tax rates per business profile (useful if you operate across multiple regions), and tax rows automatically show or hide on the invoice depending on whether tax applies. For complex multi-jurisdiction tax filings, you'll still want a dedicated accountant or tax software at year-end.

faqs.question: What happens if I outgrow Invoicor and need real accounting software later?
faqs.answer: If your business grows to the point where you need full bookkeeping, payroll, and inventory management, switching to QuickBooks or another accounting platform is straightforward. Your historical invoice and payment data exports cleanly to CSV, which any accounting tool can import. You're never locked in.

faqs.question: Can I use Invoicor in multiple currencies or languages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Invoicor supports five interface languages and lets you send invoices in any currency. If you have multiple business profiles (for example, one for freelance design work and one for a side consulting practice), each profile can have its own currency, tax setup, branding, and template.

title: FreshBooks Alternative: Flat Pricing vs Client Limits | Invoicor
meta_description: Compare Invoicor vs FreshBooks. Stop paying more just because your business is growing. Get unlimited clients and invoices with Invoicor.
h1: Don't let software punish you for growing.
subtitle: FreshBooks ties your subscription price directly to how many billable clients you have. Cross 5 clients and you're forced into the next tier. Cross 50, you jump again. Invoicor takes the opposite approach: one flat monthly rate, unlimited clients, unlimited invoices, forever. The more you grow, the more value you get for the same price.
mistake_1_text: FreshBooks' Lite plan limits you to 5 billable clients. The moment you take on your 6th client, even if it's a one-off $50 logo job, you're pushed into the Plus tier at roughly double the monthly cost. This pricing model penalizes freelancers and agencies who naturally cycle through small jobs, since every short engagement burns a client slot.
mistake_2_text: FreshBooks tries to act as a full project management platform, with project timelines, team time-tracking, expense splitting, and proposals built into the same app. If you already use Trello, Notion, Asana, or another tool for project work, FreshBooks creates a confusing parallel workflow where the same project lives in two places.
mistake_3_text: Between FreshBooks Payments processing fees, ACH bank transfer fees, and the way Stripe charges flow through the platform, calculating what you actually net per invoice requires reading a fee schedule. Bank transfer payments can also take several business days to settle, creating real cash flow friction for freelancers who need to pay rent on time.
policy_h2: Why Billable Client Limits Hurt Freelancers
policy_text: Freelancers and small agencies typically work with a mix of long-term retainer clients and short, one-off projects. Under FreshBooks' billable client model, every one-off engagement consumes a slot from your monthly allocation. A graphic designer who completes 8 small jobs in a month is forced onto a more expensive plan than a designer working with one large retainer client, even though both made similar revenue. The pricing punishes the type of business model most freelancers actually run.
solution_text: Invoicor's pricing is built on a simple promise: success shouldn't cost extra. Whether you bill 5 clients this year or 500, the monthly subscription is identical. Every client you've ever invoiced stays in your library forever, with full payment history, so you can invoice repeat customers in seconds without re-entering their details or hitting an arbitrary paywall.
stat_1_desc: Clients you can bill and store on Invoicor without ever triggering a subscription tier upgrade. Add your 6th client, 60th, or 600th at the same flat monthly price.
stat_2_desc: Project management tabs, kanban boards, or time-tracking modules cluttering the invoice creation flow. The app does one job and does it well.
pricing_them_subtext: FreshBooks Lite starts at this rate but is capped at 5 billable clients. Plus tier ($33/mo) raises the cap, Premium ($60/mo) makes it unlimited. Annual cost scales sharply as you add clients.
pricing_us_subtext: Flat rate with always-unlimited clients and invoices. No up-charges as your business grows, and no surprise renewal increases at the end of an introductory period.
target_audience_title: Who is each platform actually built for?
target_audience_us: Freelancers and small agencies who take on a mix of long-term and one-off clients, side-hustlers running multiple businesses, and contractors who already have their own project management workflow.
target_audience_them: Small agencies with 3-10 team members who specifically need integrated team time-tracking and project profitability reports, and who only work with a small number of long-term retainer clients.
step_1_text: Bring your full client list across in a single import, or rebuild it as you go. There's no penalty for keeping inactive past clients in your library, and reactivating an old client for a new project takes one tap.
step_2_text: Pick the client, add services from your saved product library, and apply tax or discount lines. The interface is built for speed: no project setup, no time-tracking entry, no expense reconciliation required before sending.
step_3_text: You see exactly when a client opens the invoice, and you get a real-time push notification the moment payment clears. Automated late-payment reminders can be configured to fire on a schedule of your choice.

faqs.question: Does Invoicor limit how many invoices I can send?
faqs.answer: No. The flat-rate subscription includes truly unlimited invoice generation. Whether you send 10 invoices a month or 10,000, the price stays the same. There are also no client caps, no team member limits, and no monthly invoice ceilings.

faqs.question: Can I set up recurring invoices on Invoicor?
faqs.answer: Yes. For retainer clients or subscription services, you can configure an invoice to generate and send automatically on a weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly schedule. The invoice number increments correctly, your branding stays consistent, and the client gets a fresh payment link each cycle.

faqs.question: What happens to my historical clients on FreshBooks if I switch?
faqs.answer: Export your client list and historical invoices from FreshBooks as a CSV, then import them into Invoicor in one step. You keep your full business history, and your inactive past clients no longer count against any limit because Invoicor doesn't have one.

faqs.question: Does Invoicor support time tracking like FreshBooks?
faqs.answer: Invoicor is intentionally not a time-tracking platform. If you bill hourly, you'd typically track time in a dedicated tool (Toggl, Harvest, or even a notes app) and then enter the total hours as a line item when invoicing. This is a deliberate scope choice. We focus on making the invoicing flow itself fast, rather than trying to be a full project management suite.

faqs.question: Can I send proposals or estimates before invoicing?
faqs.answer: Invoicor focuses on the invoicing and payment stage of the client relationship. For proposals or estimates, most freelancers use a dedicated proposal tool or send a simple PDF, then create the formal invoice in Invoicor once the work is approved. This keeps the invoicing flow lean and the proposal flow flexible.

title: Invoice2go Alternative: Modern Interface vs Legacy App | Invoicor
meta_description: Looking for an Invoice2go alternative? Switch to Invoicor for a faster mobile app, modern invoice templates, and lower payment processing friction.
h1: Upgrade to a faster, modern invoicing engine.
subtitle: Invoice2go has been on the market for over a decade, and large parts of its interface still feel like 2013. Invoice2go also tiers its plans aggressively, capping the Starter plan at 30 invoices per year and locking unlimited invoicing behind the $39.99/month Premium tier. Invoicor was rebuilt from scratch for the modern mobile contractor, with one flat price and no invoice caps at any tier.
mistake_1_text: Your invoice is a direct reflection of your brand. Many of Invoice2go's default templates haven't been visually refreshed in years and feel dated next to invoices from modern competitors. When you send a 2013-style invoice to a high-end client, it subtly signals that your business systems are stuck in the past, even if your actual service is excellent.
mistake_2_text: Invoice2go's Starter plan is capped at 30 invoices per year. The Professional plan is capped at 100. Unlimited invoicing is only available on the Premium plan at $39.99/month. Recurring invoices, the lowest card processing rate, and phone support are also locked to the top tier. The result: most growing freelancers eventually get pushed onto Premium whether they need the extra features or not.
mistake_3_text: Multiple long-term Invoice2go customers have reported significant price increases at renewal, with features they previously had access to being relocated to higher tiers. If you sign up at one price point, there's no guarantee you'll be paying the same amount in two years for the same set of features.
policy_text: Software platforms that have been in continuous development since the early 2010s accumulate technical debt: layered codebases, slower release cycles, and UI patterns that predate modern mobile design conventions. The visible result is an app that feels heavier to use than it should, with more taps required for common tasks and inconsistencies between the mobile and web experiences. Underneath, it also slows the pace of meaningful new features, since engineering time goes into maintaining old code rather than building new capabilities.
solution_text: Invoicor was built recently, on a modern Swift and SwiftUI stack, with the iPhone as the primary target rather than an afterthought. The app launches instantly, runs smoothly in low-connectivity environments on job sites, and produces PDFs that look like they came from a premium design agency rather than a 2013-era invoice template library. There's no legacy code dragging the experience down.
stat_1_desc: Time to duplicate a past invoice and send it to a new client. Invoicor's duplicate feature copies line items, tax rates, and notes, so you only update what's different.
stat_2_desc: Subscription structure with no per-invoice limits, no tier-gated features, and no surprise renewal increases tied to feature relocation.
pricing_them_subtext: Invoice2go Premium is required for unlimited invoices, recurring billing, the lowest card fees, and phone support. Cheaper tiers cap invoices at 30 or 100 per year, which most growing freelancers outgrow within months.
pricing_us_subtext: Single flat tier with unlimited invoices, unlimited clients, recurring billing, premium templates, and full feature access. No upsell pressure as your usage grows.
target_audience_title: Who is each platform actually built for?
target_audience_us: Modern mobile-first contractors, consultants, and service teams who draft and send invoices directly from their phone, and freelancers who want a flat predictable price with no per-invoice metering.
target_audience_them: Long-time Invoice2go users who are deeply embedded in the platform's ecosystem, or businesses specifically needing Invoice2go's integrated business banking and debit card product.
step_1_text: Browse a gallery of 30 modern invoice templates, including 10 premium designs with decorative details like marble veins, carbon fiber, and pseudo-element corner ornaments. Upload your logo and pick your brand colors; the template adapts automatically.
step_2_text: Build an invoice from the driver's seat of your truck in under a minute. Predictive line-item entry pulls from your saved product library, and the app keeps working even when your phone has no cellular signal. It syncs the moment you reconnect.
step_3_text: Clients receive a link to a beautifully formatted web portal, not just a flat PDF attachment. They can view the invoice, download a copy, and pay with card or Apple Pay directly in the browser, all without creating an account.

faqs.question: Can I customize the look of my Invoicor invoices?
faqs.answer: Yes. Upload your high-resolution logo (PNG with transparency works perfectly), set your exact brand hex colors, and choose from 30 designed templates that range from clean minimal palettes to premium templates with decorative CSS details like textures, ornaments, and multi-font pairings. Every template renders identically on iPhone, tablet, web, and PDF.

faqs.question: Does Invoicor work offline?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can draft invoices in dead zones on a job site, in a basement, or anywhere else without cellular signal. The app stores your drafts locally and silently syncs them to the cloud the moment your phone reconnects. Sending an invoice still requires connectivity, but drafting never does.

faqs.question: Will my Invoice2go data transfer over?
faqs.answer: You can export your client list and historical invoices from Invoice2go as a CSV, then import them into Invoicor. Your full client and invoice history is preserved, and your existing recurring invoice setup can be rebuilt in a few minutes.

faqs.question: Why is Invoicor cheaper than Invoice2go Premium?
faqs.answer: Invoice2go's Premium tier bundles features many users don't need, including integrated business banking and a debit card product. Invoicor focuses purely on the invoicing experience and uses RevenueCat for subscription management, which keeps overhead low and lets the flat $12/month price include unlimited invoicing without tier gating.

faqs.question: Can I run multiple businesses from one Invoicor account?
faqs.answer: Yes. Multi-business profile switching is built in. Each profile has its own logo, branding colors, tax setup, currency, client list, and template. Switch between your freelance design business and your side consulting practice with a single tap, without logging out or maintaining two separate accounts.

title: Stripe Invoicing Alternative: Built for Mobile vs Built for Developers | Invoicor
meta_description: Stripe is built for tech companies and developers. Invoicor is built for service businesses who need to send invoices directly from their iPhone.
h1: Built for developers, not for contractors.
subtitle: Stripe is an incredible payment gateway, but their standalone Stripe Invoicing product is designed for tech companies with development teams. Navigating the Stripe dashboard on a mobile phone to send a quick bill is a nightmare of nested menus and technical jargon. Invoicor gives you Stripe's power with a beautiful, mobile-first interface.
mistake_1_text: Stripe's dashboard is cluttered with API keys, webhook configurations, and developer tools. Finding the invoice generation screen requires dodging menus built for software engineers, not service providers.
mistake_2_text: Stripe Invoicing charges a percentage fee (often 0.4% to 0.5%) on top of their standard payment processing fees just for the privilege of using their invoice templates. For high-ticket items, this fee dwarfs the cost of a flat-rate subscription.
mistake_3_text: Stripe does not have a dedicated, user-friendly mobile app for drafting and sending invoices on the go. You are forced to use a mobile browser to pinch-and-zoom around a desktop-class dashboard.
policy_text: When a platform charges a percentage fee just to use their invoice software, you are penalized for success. A $10,000 project billed through Stripe Invoicing will cost you an extra $40 just in software fees, on top of the credit card processing. That's absurd.
solution_text: Invoicor offers a stunning, fast, native iOS experience that connects to your bank without skimming off the top of every invoice. You get the reliability of modern payment rails without the developer interface or the hidden percentage fees.
stat_1_desc: Extra software fees Invoicor takes per invoice. You only pay standard card gateway fees.
stat_2_desc: Tap required to open Invoicor on your iPhone and start billing.
pricing_them_subtext: Stripe Invoicing charges a percentage of your total bill on top of standard processing fees, which scales endlessly as your revenue grows.
pricing_us_subtext: A flat, predictable $12/mo. Whether you bill $100 or $100,000, your software cost never changes.
target_audience_title: Who is each platform actually built for?
target_audience_us: Mobile professionals, contractors, and freelancers who need an app that is fast, beautiful, and transparently priced.
target_audience_them: SaaS companies and developers who need programmatic API access to automatically generate millions of receipts.

step_2_text: Stop paying percentage 'software fees' on your hard work. Pay one flat monthly rate.
step_3_text: Send invoices that look incredibly professional, rather than standard, unbranded Stripe receipts.
